elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 14a applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires TrueLink, at Client's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(a) expressly provides transition assistance for up to six (6) months.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(a) specifies that assistance will be provided at TrueLink's then-current rates.

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(b) requires TrueLink, within thirty days after expiration or termination, to return all Client Content and other Client data in its possession or control to Client.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(b) requires return in a commonly used, machine-readable format, which satisfies the standard machine-readable format requirement.

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor must delete it.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(c) requires TrueLink thereafter to delete the returned Client Content and data from its systems.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(c) requires TrueLink to certify the deletion to Client in writing.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 14a applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and obligates TrueLink to provide transition assistance at Client's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: The assistance period of up to six months exceeds the fallback 90-day period.

elements.element: Vendor must export Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(b) requires TrueLink to return all Client Content and other Client data to Client in a machine-readable format.

elements.element: The Customer Data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(b) expressly imposes a thirty-day deadline following expiration or termination.

result.reason: The added clause fully implements the preferred position and therefore also satisfies the fallback. Its added detail concerning data in TrueLink's possession or control, examples of covered data, deletion from systems, and written certification clarifies the required transition and data-return obligations without changing unrelated commercial terms or creating a contradiction.
